tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: World Series Game 5, and Milwaukee is one win from the franchise's first title after Tampa Bay's 4-3, 12-inning escape in Game 4 kept the series alive. The Brewers turn to ace Jacob Misiorowski (16-5, 1.80 ERA) on four days' rest — the clearest pitching edge of the series — while the Rays had not named a starter after emptying the pen in 12 innings Tuesday. Junior Caminero says he'll play on a bad left foot, and Cash promised he'd play 'on one leg.' No true edge at the current prices — the market has Milwaukee priced right — but the lean is the Brewers because the pitching matchup is the most lopsided of the series.
games.title: World Series Game 5
games.verdict: LEAN: MIL — no true edge, but the lean is Milwaukee because Misiorowski on four days' rest is the series' clearest pitching advantage.

games.matchup: Los Angeles Lakers @ Los Angeles Clippers
games.take: Round two of the LA rivalry, five days after the Lakers' 125-117 win in the first meeting. The Lakers are 3-1 but on the second night of a back-to-back after Tuesday's 136-129 home loss to Portland, despite 41 from Luka Doncic (144 points in four games). The Clippers are 1-2 and missing six rotation players — Beal, Ingram, Strus, Hachimura, Miller and Niederhauser. This is also a board play: Courtside is hanging the Clippers at +168 against a 37.9% devigged Pinnacle fair, +1.6% EV — a price-gap edge on a depleted side, not a vote of confidence in the Clippers' depth.
games.title: Lakers @ Clippers
games.verdict: LEAN: LAC +168 — a real edge, not just a lean: Courtside is hanging +168 against a 37.9% fair.

games.take: The unbeaten Thunder (4-0) keep winning shorthanded — Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Caruso and Wallace are all out, with Ajay Mitchell questionable after a career-high 30 against Phoenix. Dallas has its own questions: Irving is questionable with knee injury management, Marshall is ill, Martin has a thumb sprain, and Lively is out. No true edge at US prices — the only number beating fair was an exchange price — but the lean is the Thunder because 4-0 shorthanded beats a Mavericks side that can't say who's playing.
games.title: Thunder @ Mavericks
games.verdict: LEAN: OKC — no true edge, but the lean is Oklahoma City because the 4-0 record has already survived the injury list.

games.take: Minnesota's season changes tonight: Anthony Edwards, averaging 33.3 points through four games, is headed for arthroscopic knee surgery and could miss up to two months after his 47-point night in Monday's overtime loss to Cleveland. The Wolves lean on McDaniels (15.0 PPG), offseason addition LaMelo Ball (14.8 PPG, 6.3 APG) and Shannon off the bench. Golden State is 1-3 after its first win Monday over Denver behind Podziemski and rookie Yaxel Lendeborg. This is also a board play: FanDuel is hanging Minnesota at -154 against a 61.1% devigged Pinnacle fair, +0.8% EV — Pinnacle moved on the Edwards news and FanDuel hasn't caught up.
games.title: Warriors @ Timberwolves
games.verdict: LEAN: MIN -154 — a real edge, not just a lean: FanDuel is hanging -154 against a 61.1% fair.

games.take: A big road number for the Knicks, who are laying 7.5 in Chicago. The fair line says New York wins this one about seven times in ten, but the US prices have already caught up — the best Knicks price implies more than the fair, so there is no edge to bet, only a lean to state. The Bulls at +219 imply less than the fair too, so the least-bad side of the market is the favorite. No true edge here, but the lean is New York because the gap between price and fair is smallest on the Knicks' side.
games.title: Knicks @ Bulls
games.verdict: LEAN: NYK — no true edge, but the lean is New York because the price-vs-fair gap is smallest on the favorite's side.

games.matchup: Jacksonville State Gamecocks @ New Mexico State Aggies
games.take: Week 9 CUSA under the lights in Las Cruces. Jacksonville State is 5-2 and unbeaten in league play (3-0) on four straight wins, the latest a 27-24 win over FIU, with dual-threat QB Caden Creel (1,637 passing yards, 12 TDs, plus a team-high 500 rushing yards) driving the offense. New Mexico State is 3-4 and 2-1 in the league after a 30-24 win at Sam Houston, leaning on CUSA rushing leader James Jones (777 yards, 6.5 per carry, 178 last out) and a run defense allowing just 109.1 yards a game. This is also a board play: ESPN BET is hanging the Aggies at +145 against a 41.9% devigged Pinnacle fair, +2.6% EV — the home dog with the ground game is getting too many points in the price.
games.title: Jacksonville State @ New Mexico State
games.verdict: LEAN: NMSU +145 — a real edge, not just a lean: ESPN BET is hanging +145 against a 41.9% fair.
